_metadata.description: Per-component preview harness that executes real React inside an isolated iframe, wired via @vrooli/iframe-bridge.

requirements.title: Per-component harness page renders the actual React component (not placeholder HTML)
requirements.description: API serves `GET /api/v1/preview/{component_id}` returning an HTML shell that imports the component's bundled source and mounts it via `ReactDOM.createRoot`. The shell calls `initIframeBridgeChild()` on load. Bundling approach (esbuild service vs pre-bundled chunks with dynamic import) is captured in `docs/RESEARCH.md` and chosen before slice 3 of Phase 4.

validation.notes: BAS flow `preview-renders-component` loads a known component, asserts the iframe DOM contains expected rendered output.

requirements.title: Reload-on-save: editor save triggers iframe NAV via the host bridge
requirements.description: After the editor PUT succeeds, the UI invokes the host-side `@vrooli/iframe-bridge` NAV message to reload the harness. Warm reload latency target is < 1s on a 50KB component on a developer-class machine.

validation.notes: BAS flow `edit-and-preview` edits a string in Monaco, saves, and asserts the iframe reflects the change.

requirements.title: Preview iframe is served same-origin from the library API with sandbox attributes
requirements.description: The harness page is served by the library's own API on a dedicated harness path so the bridge can inspect freely. The `<iframe>` carries the sandbox attribute set documented in `vrooli-ui-interop`; no third-party origins are loaded.

validation.notes: api/handlers/preview/module_test.go asserts the harness route returns HTML with same-origin /preview/runtime imports and the runtime route serves JavaScript. ui/src/features/components/ComponentEditor.test.tsx asserts the iframe uses the harness URL and sandbox attributes. ui/server.test.js asserts the production UI server proxies /preview harness and runtime paths to the API before SPA fallback, preventing recursive loading of the library UI inside the iframe.

requirements.title: Preview runtime honors declared React ranges
requirements.description: The preview harness resolves declared `react` and `react-dom` dependency ranges to the newest supported runtime candidate, serves the vendored React runtime from same-origin `/preview/runtime/...` URLs, and surfaces an in-iframe import-map diagnostic when the resolved runtime is unavailable locally. Runtime imports are guarded with dynamic imports so module failures render in `#preview-error` instead of leaving a blank iframe.

validation.notes: api/internal/deps/semver_test.go covers range-to-latest resolution for wildcard, caret, tilde, comparator, compound, exact, missing, and unparseable ranges. api/handlers/preview/static_test.go verifies React imports point at same-origin /preview/runtime URLs, unavailable vendored runtime versions render diagnostics while falling back to React 18.3.1, harness CSS contains the design tokens/Tailwind app utilities, and runtime/component import failures are inside a catchable dynamic-import path. api/handlers/preview/module_test.go verifies the runtime route serves JavaScript without esm.sh.

requirements.title: Preview bundler resolves relative imports and local dependency runtimes
requirements.description: The preview bundler uses esbuild Build with a source-directory ResolveDir so relative imports are bundled into the component module. Bare package imports remain external and are resolved by a per-preview import map. Non-React declared dependencies resolve through the same semver range function used by the deps domain and map to same-origin `/preview/runtime/npm/<package>@<version>/...` URLs when the package version is installed locally; unresolved ranges surface an import-map diagnostic.

validation.notes: api/internal/preview/service_test.go::TestEsbuilderBundlesRelativeImports proves Build-based relative import bundling. api/handlers/preview/static_test.go::TestBuildImportMapJSONPinsDeclaredDeps verifies non-React dependencies map to same-origin runtime URLs with no esm.sh, and TestBuildImportMapJSONUsesResolvedDependencyVersionPerBundle proves conflicting declared ranges produce independent import maps.

requirements.title: Preview failures surface in the host UI
requirements.description: The harness posts `preview-error` messages to the parent when render setup fails or the component has no callable export. The host editor listens for those messages, captures iframe load errors and preview timeouts, and renders a clear retryable failure state instead of leaving the preview waiting indefinitely.

validation.notes: api/handlers/preview/static_test.go asserts harness render failures post `preview-error`. ui/src/features/components/ComponentEditor.test.tsx asserts a `preview-error` message renders the failure panel and retry reloads the iframe with a fresh retry key. `pnpm type-check`, `pnpm lint`, and targeted Go preview tests passed.
